status: source descriptions for planning, not experimentally confirmed model evidence
global_rules: Never concatenate counts, TPM/FPKM, normalized values, or microarray ratios as a common count matrix.
Keep study, organism, biological unit, cell type, maintenance history, and elapsed release time separate.
Do not make depth labels from duration or clock. Do not treat differential statistics as individual sample expression.
A catalogue accession or downloaded file does not mean training admission. Preserve prior frozen roles.
All current executable assays are adaptive development, not independent confirmation.
Propose public-study experiments as pending with required parsing/mapping; do not describe them as executed by the current three-view loop.

studies.title: Transcriptomic analysis of senescent cells upon EXOC7 knockdown
studies.design_to_verify: Five siRNA/4OHT arms with three biological replicates each (15 libraries): scramble no 4OHT, scramble +4OHT, EXOC7 siRNA-3 +4OHT, EXOC7 siRNA-4 +4OHT, PTBP1 siRNA-5 +4OHT; collected 5 days after induction.
studies.unit_rule: Treat 4OHT × siRNA as actual perturbation identities. Do not count EXOC7/PTBP1 siRNA as additional senescence controls; keep matched scramble group in comparisons and replicate blocks together.
studies.limitations: One 5-day endpoint, no full senescence recovery clock.
studies.ai_brief: Human EXOC7 knockdown/senescence count spreadsheet. Parse siRNA x induction contrasts and biological replicate/control relationships.

studies.title: Human dermal fibroblast quiescence and serum refeeding series
studies.design_to_verify: Normal human dermal fibroblasts held under 0.1% FCS for 48h; refeeding sampled nominal 0/6/12/18/24/30/36/42/48 h. 24 arrays total; GEO sample-to-time/replicate mapping must be audited.
studies.unit_rule: Array / culture is the independent measured unit; distinguish repeated technical spots or pooled profiles from biological replicates. Study-processed RMA/ComBat values are not raw RNA counts or fully leakage-free held-out normalization.
studies.limitations: Cohort-wide normalization can use test-set distribution information. Do not call this fresh cross-platform prospectively blinded validation.
studies.ai_brief: Human fibroblast refeeding, processed microarrays. Technical repeats are not biological units; audit joint normalization and probe mappings.

studies.title: Graded regulation of cellular quiescence depth between proliferation and senescence by a lysosomal dimmer switch
studies.design_to_verify: Serum starvation day 0, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, each with 3 independent culture replicates = 30 libraries.
studies.unit_rule: Independent culture is unit, not a time series of the same cell. Day 0 is non-arrest reference; day 2 onward arrested per source. Transcriptomic duration should not be equated to functional depth without stimulus-response measurements.
studies.limitations: The old thesis 9 dormant/3 active contrast is only a subset of the full 10×3 time series.
studies.ai_brief: Rat fibroblast starvation duration, FPKM, independent cultures. Duration is not a per-sample functional depth label.

studies.title: Transcriptome Signature of Cellular Senescence
studies.design_to_verify: 37 GEO samples from 8 senescence models, across WI-38/IMR-90 fibroblast and HUVEC/HAEC endothelial backgrounds; triggers include replicative exhaustion, radiation, doxorubicin and HRASG12V.
studies.unit_rule: Model/cell-type/induction/replicate are jointly stratified. Do not mix untreated fibroblasts and treated endothelial cells into one universal control. Separate true senescence from reversible arrest and acute DNA-damage stress.
studies.limitations: These cells are permanently senescent comparison, not a recovery trajectory.
studies.ai_brief: Human cellular senescence comparator. RAW.tar contains processed per-sample TXT, not FASTQ; group cell line, induction and shared controls.

studies.title: Gene Expression Patterns of Quiescent and Activated Mouse Primary Hepatic Stellate Cell
studies.design_to_verify: Three control mice (olive oil) and three CCl4-treated mice; activated stellate cells vs quiescent HSCs, six sample libraries.
studies.unit_rule: Each mouse = independent biological unit; keep injury/treatment effect separate from arrest state; do not call this pure proliferation controlled experiment.
studies.limitations: Composition/injury confounding; two-state reference not a dynamic release timeline.
studies.ai_brief: Mouse hepatic stellate quiescent/activated FPKM table; a state contrast, not a validated dense exit clock.

studies.title: Fasting Induces a Highly Resilient Deep Quiescent State in Muscle Stem Cells via Ketone Body Signaling
studies.design_to_verify: Eight libraries: PBS controls P1–P4 and ketone-treated MuSC K1–K4, FACS-sorted from WT mouse cells.
studies.unit_rule: Independent mouse/preparation replication needs provenance; do not treat four files as a time series. Expression measures treatment-associated state, while delayed activation and stress survival are group-level functional evidence from paper, not necessarily paired to these eight RNA libraries.
studies.limitations: Normalized reads are not raw counts; functional outcome not guaranteed per RNA source.
studies.ai_brief: Mouse muscle stem quiescence, normalized reads in XLSX. Functional evidence does not imply matched individual RNA-function labels.

studies.rule: Archive only. No training, model selection, or outcome-derived knowledge ingestion.
studies.ai_brief: Inherited heldout/excluded family. Archive only; do not train, select models or ingest outcome-derived evidence from this source.

studies.title: Transcriptome sequencing analysis of satellite cells by RNA-seq
studies.design_to_verify: RNA profiles of adult muscle satellite-cell quiescence exit, injury activation, regeneration and ageing, across separate activation.csv, ageing.csv, regeneration.csv.
studies.unit_rule: Recover sample IDs, injury time (hours/dpi), treatment and animal/replicate from SOFT. Preserve subseries and aged group; do not conflate injury day with in vitro activation or assume paired mouse repeated measures.
studies.limitations: Physiological activation study not necessarily a recovery from embryonic diapause; mixed designs across arms.
studies.ai_brief: Muscle stem activation/ageing/regeneration tables; audit units, conditions and scales, keeping distinct branches separate.

studies.title: The landscape of therapeutic vulnerabilities in EGFR inhibitor osimertinib drug tolerant persister cells
studies.system: Homo sapiens; PC9, NCI-H1975, HCC827, HCC2935
studies.design_to_verify: 4 EGFR-mutant NSCLC lines × 5 conditions × 3 biological replicates = 60 libraries. 500 nM osimertinib 21d DTP; 24h acute; DMSO; DTP short washout 24h; long washout until regrowth (PC9 7d, NCI-H1975 3d, HCC827 4d, HCC2935 10d).
studies.unit_rule: Culture replicate is independent unit within each cell line; split by line and biological replicate family. Long washout elapsed time is cell-line-specific, not a shared clock; short/long washout are cross-sectional cultures, not tracked single cells.
studies.limitations: Drug-tolerant cancer persistence is an analogy to embryonic diapause, not equivalent to vertebrate diapause. Long washout time differs by line.
studies.ai_brief: Human drug-tolerant persister cell lines; estimated counts and log2TPM are two views of the same samples. Keep cell line and treatment context.

studies.title: m6A RNA methylation orchestrates transcriptional dormancy during developmental pausing
studies.design_to_verify: E14 mouse ESC Mettl3 WT versus KO, FBS/LIF unpaused versus 200 nM INK128 mTOR-inhibited paused (2 weeks for sequencing); 12 RNA samples (three replicates per genotype×state contrast).
studies.scale_or_assay: Raw counts with ERCC and separately cell-number-normalised log2 expression
studies.unit_rule: Independent culture replicate is unit; retain gene genotype, paused/control state, ERCC counts, culture line, and cell-number input; do not use 2×10^5 input cell count as a separate expression sample. Do not merge ERCC, counts and log2 matrices as interchangeable.
studies.limitations: mTOR-inhibited cultured ESCs are not whole killifish embryos; cross-system clock values cannot be equated.
studies.ai_brief: Mettl3 WT/KO x mTOR-paused ESCs. Keep raw counts with ERCC separate from cell-number-normalized log expression; culture replicate is the unit.

studies.title: TET activity safeguards pluripotency throughout embryonic dormancy
studies.design_to_verify: WT ESC at 0 h, 24 h, 72 h, 144 h under Ink128; TET1/2 double KO at 0 h, 24 h, 72 h. Two independent RNA samples per condition = 14 RNA samples. Subseries of GSE221470; do not count both as independent studies.
studies.scale_or_assay: TPM BED per sample, not raw counts
studies.unit_rule: Culture replicate is unit; genotype and elapsed drug treatment are distinct covariates. TET KO 144 h is not present in this RNA subseries. Track loci, not simply number of BED files; duplicated loci must be reconciled before aggregation.
studies.limitations: TPM is neither raw counts nor spike-in-normalised absolute RNA. Assay branches are distinct; 14 RNA ≠ 266 multi-assay deposited specimens.
studies.ai_brief: TET WT/DKO induction time series, locus TPM BED; no DKO 144 h. Resolve duplicate loci; do not convert TPM into raw counts.

studies.title: Autofluorescence is a biomarker of neural stem cell activation state [Subventricular zone]
studies.design_to_verify: SVZ neural stem cells from eight male mice on three separate experiment days/plates; 3 GEO sample records. Optical/autofluorescence grading is associated with live activation behaviour.
studies.unit_rule: Three plates are not automatically three independent mice; recover mouse/cell link from deposited metadata where available. Graded optical state is ordinal quiescence, NOT elapsed days in dormancy. Cells from same mouse/plate stay together in split.
studies.limitations: Reported per-cell metadata must be checked to confirm individual mouse identities before animal-level pseudobulk.
studies.ai_brief: Mouse neural stem activation/autofluorescence, counts and cell metadata. Three GEO plate records are not three independent animals; resolve lineage.

studies.title: A single cell atlas of mouse embryonic diapause and peri-implantation development
studies.design_to_verify: Four pooled stage libraries: E5.5, EDG7.5, EDG9.5, Reactivated; approximately 200–250 blastocysts per major stage, 50 at E5.5. Processed archive is TAR of TSVs.
studies.unit_rule: Cell IDs within the same pooled stage sample are not biological embryo replicates. Do not perform naive per-cell significance with n equal to cell number. Use this primarily for directional/transfer evaluation and morphology-associated endpoints.
studies.limitations: No independent replicate series in four-stage GEO sample design; stage separation is not an external biological replicate estimate.
studies.ai_brief: Mouse diapause/peri-implantation single-cell TSV archive; assay scale, embryo/pool lineage and cell metadata need audit before grouped modeling.

studies.title: Age deceleration and reversal gene patterns in dauer diapause
studies.design_to_verify: Dauer 1/4/15/30 days; for each arrest history, samples at release 0/6/24 hours, plus L3 reference and UV arms. Study GEO describes 54 samples. Treat history days separately from time-after-exit; UV is a perturbation arm.
studies.unit_rule: Biological RNA pool/replicate is the inference unit. Do not treat samples at different times as tracked individual worms. Previous VDC alpha used 24 development pools (replicates 1/2), validation rep 2 for some tasks and reserved/test rep 3; never silently reassign prior holdouts.
studies.limitations: No RNA-to-functional-recovery paired cohort; any reference-derived clock is not an independently measured biological clock.
studies.ai_brief: Dauer history x exit time, fractional Salmon estimates; pooled replicate blocks and prior test roles remain fixed. History is not exit clock or depth.

studies.title: A TFEB–TGFβ axis systemically regulates diapause, stem cell resilience and protects against senescence
studies.design_to_verify: Four genotypes: N2, hlh-30(tm1978), daf-1(m40), double mutant; each sampled after 48 h adult reproductive diapause, or after 12 h refeeding following 48 h ARD; four nominal replicates per group = 32 GEO records.
studies.scale_or_assay: Deposited DESeq2-normalized abundance, not raw integer counts
studies.unit_rule: Deposited matrix has 30 columns even though GEO lists 32 samples. Missing columns: hlh30_REC_REP4 and daf1_48_REP3 (record exact deposited labels). Pair each genotype with matched N2 within treatment and replicate block. Different genotype comparisons share controls and are not independent contrasts. Previously rep 4 reserved; do not change.
studies.limitations: Constitutive mutants are not acute knockouts; treatment state and genotype must remain explicit.
studies.ai_brief: Persistent genotypes x ARD/refeeding; normalized abundance, 30 matrix columns versus 32 GEO records. Shared controls and reserved replicate remain grouped.

studies.title: C. elegans Dauer and 12h Dauer-exit versus mixed-stage microarray
studies.design_to_verify: 8 arrays: four dauer vs mixed-stage common-reference and four 12h after dauer exit vs common-reference, dye swaps included.
studies.unit_rule: Keep dye-swap/reference channels and 4 true biological replicates per arm; ratio-to-mixed-stage is not equivalent to absolute expression or longitudinal sampled individuals.
studies.limitations: GEO processed values are in sample tables, not necessarily in supplementary TAR; no zero-as-control.
studies.ai_brief: Dauer and one 12 h exit endpoint versus mixed-stage reference, two-colour array values inside SOFT. Not counts or a dense recovery series.

studies.title: Global analysis of dauer gene expression in Caenorhabditis elegans
studies.design_to_verify: 94 arrays divided among Dauer MTC exit, L1 MTC starvation release, Dauer Adjust 0 vs 12 h. Four independent time series; 4 h and 7 h dauer cases have only 3 replicates. Dauer MTC branch has 42 arrays in curated project inventory.
studies.unit_rule: MTC# is a starting worm pool, time points are aliquots of the same pool. Each array uses shared reference RefB-JW. A trailing -2 indicates repeat hybridization of same RNA, not a biological replicate. Retain dye channel, platform, times, and pool ID.
studies.limitations: Do not merge array measurement values with RNA-seq counts or treat technical -2 repeats as independent.
studies.ai_brief: Dauer MTC two-colour arrays: group aliquots by starting MTC pool, preserve common reference and technical rehybridizations. Probe mapping required.

studies.title: Gene function and expression profiling in yeast spores, killifish diapause embryos, and their post-dormant offspring cells
studies.design_to_verify: S. pombe: spores versus vegetative/stationary controls; spore ageing at 2 weeks/3 months/5 months; 45°C 1 h spore heat stress; offspring cultured 14–16 h after germination from distinct spore histories; Bar-seq deletion-screen separate. Killifish: GRZ developing versus diapause; MZCS diapause 2 weeks/3 months; 40°C 1 h heat stress; post-diapause one-week pre-hatching after early/late/stressed origin.
studies.scale_or_assay: Raw ENA RNA-seq FASTQ, PRIDE/MassIVE proteomics separate; processed RNA matrix availability to audit
studies.unit_rule: ENA PRJEB80774 covers BOTH organisms and multiple assays. Never treat run count as biological n or spore G0 as equivalent to nitrogen-starvation G0. S. pombe state RNA three biological replicates/group; spore age 3/2/2 for young/3mo/5mo (catalogue); offspring 3/group. GRZ RNA pools ≈50 embryos/replicate and protein pools ≈10; MZCS duration RNA ≈50 embryos/pool; RNA/protein sample pools are not necessarily physically paired. Sample mapping must be verified from ENA BioSample/Methods. Do not use Bar-seq as RNA count matrix.
studies.limitations: User points to bioRxiv v1; data catalogue may reflect v2. Verify v1-versus-v2 sample-design differences. Do not compare age-duration days with hours-after-release or cross-species clocks as one quantity.
studies.download_scope: Only four listed FASTQs: two paired-end runs, one per organism. This is not a replicated study matrix or the entire project.
studies.ai_brief: Only two paired-end runs (four FASTQs), one killifish and one fission yeast. Raw reads need reference-pinned quantification; not a replicated matrix.
